inventedEvidence.evidence: "Thanks for confirming the display is on." — the customer had only said buttons beep and it won't start; nothing about the display had been said yet.

rationale: The assistant reached the correct cause (child lock, hold Stop ~3s) within a few turns and correctly concluded no part was needed, which matches the hidden truth. However, it stated 'Thanks for confirming the display is on' before the customer had mentioned the display at all, and it asked about a 'door' message before asking what the display showed. It also repeated the control-lock question verbatim after the customer said they would try it, wasting a turn, though this did not block progress.
